The fixed compensated U8 prefix has no helper with a smaller terminal frame under monotone equal-common-frame invertible ADD/nonzero SCALE cleanup on the same arbitrary dirty registers. This adds one isolated research directory, independently certifying all 504 exact endpoint cones, including the 126 existing low-ended helpers. It is an independent finite verification / scoped negative result, with no new kappa.

For each helper q the certificate joins its end-B frame, exact inverse-row support frames and dirty-column support frames. Every joined subspace equals its current endpoint. The row/monotonicity test alone closes 496; the dirty-column condition closes the remaining dimension for helpers 347,349,359,361,370,371,372,373. Current and necessary widths remain {4:80,5:32,7:54,8:122,9:216}.

The two implementations use chronological Fraction rows versus right-composed integer/dyadic columns and exhaustive 512-vector GF2 subspaces. Both reconstruct compensation, the 12913-gate prefix, all 728 arbitrary-input endpoint columns and exact inverse identity; every support/frame record agrees. The written growing-high-frame-subsystem invariant states the precise cleanup hypotheses.

Reproduce with Python >=3.10:
```sh
python3 -I -B research/u8-terminal-cone-census/verify.py
```
Expected: PASS_EXACT_INDEPENDENT_U8_TERMINAL_CONE_CENSUS.

Validation: independent census and static review; all 504 valid endpoints and 4186 proper basis-deletion rejections; eight actual row-only false admissions; four reproducible semantic properties plus six separately executed semantic mutation rejections; actual corrupted-input/output-preservation/source-closure/false-certificate controls; normal and optimized interpreters; committed minimal-directory archive replay in an empty location; all 24 Git blobs and own-fork tree matched; selected-record check at the pinned base; whitespace check. Full make verify and cold selected replay were not rerun for this isolated research addition.

COST.md replaces the provisional single-final-climb screen with the actual split suffix and a favorable all-728 one-jump relaxation, returned-width idle accounting and complete recurrence obligations. It does not certify a numerical no-gain bound. Cheaper tails at unchanged endpoints, changed prefixes/end-B frames, additional storage or a different cleanup/compiler interface remain open. No native construction, global optimality, runtime gain, human peer approval or full multiplication theorem is claimed.
